omissions: The substantial comic episode about the protagonist translating the “Giant Gravity” passage is omitted.
The detailed basis for Meitei’s suicidal impulse and the narrator’s observations about the flowers and class treatment are omitted.
distortions: The adaptation says the master, K寒月, and Meitei laughed together about Tofu, whereas the original mainly has Meitei joking and the master later criticizing him.
It says K寒月 jumped down from the bridge and landed on the bridge; the original has him jump from the railing onto the bridge center while mistakenly believing he had jumped into the water.
It implies the master recovered exactly when four o’clock struck; the original says his nausea stopped then and his full recovery followed shortly afterward.
language_problems: “橋から飛び降りたのに、橋の上へ落ちた” is confusing and internally unnatural.
“主人を毎朝大きな声を出す教師” is awkwardly phrased.
“時刻を過ぎ” is vague in context.
